positions.as_written: Assess the effusion's size and compliance, since a large compliant effusion suggests a slow accumulation.
Assess the temperature, because warmth moves the differential towards inflammation, crystal disease or infection.
Examine the other joints and ask about systemic symptoms, since a knee is one joint of several in inflammatory disease.
Examine the popliteal fossa, since a chronic effusion commonly fills a cyst.
